senses.definition: To alter, to change into something new; to revolutionize.
senses.example: But the most frequent maladies are such as proceed from themselves, as first when religion and God's service is neglected, innovated or altered […].
synonyms: boldly go where no man has gone before

senses.definition: To introduce something new to a particular environment; to do something new.
senses.example: Japanese retail stores have strove to, and have succeeded in, fulfilling these severe demands, and in doing so, have constantly had to innovate both technologically and institutionally in order to keep up with the competition.
synonyms: boldly go where no man has gone before

senses.example: to innovate a word or an act
